wholePhysicalScope: Named OpenStreetMap way 1026090385, tagged with Birdsville Courthouse and Wikidata Q28035357, identifies the articulated roof over the standing building near Adelaide and Macdonald Streets. This outline controls the location and orientation of the original court and attached residence.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the masonry court and long residence, transverse gables, hipped roof, chimney and east porch. Near levels resolve sash, corrugation and cladding.
limitations: The circa-1925 photograph establishes persistent roof, post and masonry features. Later enclosures use the written heritage description and the current mapped roof perimeter.
The pale limewash represents the surveyed historical treatment. Present shades, enclosure openings, joinery and exact heights are estimated.
The separate lockup and Aboriginal tracker’s hut are outside the mapped courthouse model. An original open terrain field is sampled without sculpting.
